propositions: A new advisory AGENT-tier container criterion (decomp-shape) must detect layer-cake decompositions where children are partitioned by architectural layer rather than vertical slices, causing un-demoable individual tasks and deferred integration risk.

The decomp-shape criterion must detect consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge patterns where a child consumes an artifact produced by a sibling but lacks an explicit ordering dependency, allowing parallel schedulers to start the consumer before the producer exists.

The decomp-shape criterion must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM and AGENT_TIER (not CODEBASE_GROUNDED), added to CONTAINER_CRITERIA, and routed with facet=container, scope=[container], and default_posture=advisory.
The eval_solver container arm must be extended to run container criteria over fixture children lists via pass1_container, enabling bounded sanity calibration without batch-eval costs.

Promotion from advisory to blocking posture is gated on both criterion effectiveness metrics (detection_proxy, blocking_fp_proxy) AND E6 order-stability clearing floor (fleiss_kappa >= 0.6), with E6's current instability (fleiss_kappa=0.55) deferring blocking-promotion indefinitely.

Bounded sanity fixtures must demonstrate recall=1.0 on layer-cake and consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge positives and false-accept=0.0 on vertical-slice and ordered producer-consumer negatives, committed to decomp_shape_sanity.json.
